summary: Download Bulk Replace Request Errors CSV
description: Downloads a CSV of the errors recorded for a bulk replace request, with one row per project or company, tool, error type, and error message. Requests with no recorded errors return a JSON message instead of a CSV.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the workflow bulk replace request.

parameters.name: Accept
parameters.description: Must be set to text/csv for CSV download

message.description: Localized notice returned when the request recorded no errors.

403.description: Forbidden - User does not have bulk manage assignees permission

404.description: Not Found - Request does not exist

406.description: Not Acceptable - Accept header was not set to text/csv
